title: Counting the Coverage Months Falling Beyond the Day a Rider Ends
content:
The coverage months that fall beyond the day one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders ends, and are therefore refunded, are counted as follows.

## The rule

**Where a rider service intake stands asking for the rider to be cancelled and the rider record carries no day it ended**, the coverage months beyond the end are the coverage months a billing cycle carries, less the month in which that intake reached the plan and less any whole calendar month that has passed since.

**Where the rider record carries a day the rider ended**, the coverage months beyond the end are the coverage months a billing cycle carries, less the month that day falls in and less any whole calendar month that has passed since.

**Otherwise**, no coverage month falls beyond the day the rider ends.

## Condition and count

| The member's rider service requests | The rider record | The count |
|---|---|---|
| A cancellation intake standing | No day the rider ended | The coverage months a billing cycle carries, less the month the intake reached the plan and less any whole calendar month since |
| Either | A day the rider ended | The coverage months a billing cycle carries, less the month that day falls in and less any whole calendar month since |
| No cancellation intake standing | No day the rider ended | None |

In every case the count is never fewer than none.

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

Take a billing cycle carrying 3 coverage months.

- A cancellation intake reached the plan in the month of handling, the record carrying no day the rider ended: 3 less the month the intake reached the plan and less no further whole month gives 2.
- A cancellation intake reached the plan 1 whole calendar month before the month of handling: 3 less that month and less the 1 whole month since gives 1.
- A cancellation intake reached the plan 2 whole calendar months before the month of handling: 3 less that month and less the 2 whole months since gives none.
- The record carrying a day the rider ended in the month of handling: 3 less the month that day falls in gives 2.
- On a billing cycle carrying a single coverage month, a cancellation intake reaching the plan in the month of handling gives none.
